rows.text: The Ministry of Welfare's resolution No. 1/3/91-CC.I of 29 March 1991, reconstituting the National Committee for the Centenary Celebrations of Baba Saheb Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar, lists as member 29 'Shri S. R. Bommai, President, Janata Dal, Sardar Patel Bhavan, 7, Jantar Mantar Road, New Delhi-110001'.
